title.note: Game title, glossary keep: brand with no localized title.

hud.reel.note: 'Izvuci' (pull the fish out) rather than literal 'Namotaj' (wind the reel): clearer for kids on a big action button. Same verb as the pass Autoizvlačenje.

hud.bait_left.note: Label form: count can be 0, 1 or more and Bosnian has three plural forms.

catch.success.note: 'Caught: {fish} ({rarity})!' -- neuter participle avoids the gendered 'Ulovio/Ulovila si', and the colon keeps {fish} in the nominative with no adjective agreement (guide pattern 'Kupljeno: {item}').

catch.escaped.note: 'It' made explicit as the generic 'riba' (fish); the feminine past agrees with it for any species.

catch.new_record.note: For the developer: {weight} arrives as '12.4'; Bosnian writes a decimal comma ('12,4'), so format it per locale in code.

fish.lantern_eel.note: Head-first hyphenated name like 'čovjek-pauk'; 'fenjer' (lantern) is the everyday BiH word and keeps the lantern idea. Alternative if a reviewer prefers: 'Svjetleća jegulja' (17).

rarity.mythic.note: Masculine tier label, matching 'Legendarni' and 'Rijetki' (guide: rarity tags in the masculine; implied noun 'ulov').

shop.equipped.note: State label; masculine agrees with 'štap' (rod). Pairs with the button 'Opremi'.

shop.free.note: Fits the 8-char budget; common in BiH shops. 'Besplatno' (9) is the more neutral word if the label has one more character of room.

pass.auto_reel.note: Same verb as hud.reel (izvući); 'auto' written together like 'autopilot', 'autofokus'. 14/14; hyphenated 'Auto-izvlačenje' would be 15.

pass.lucky_bait.text: Mamac sreće udvostručuje šansu za rijetke ribe!
pass.lucky_bait.note: 'Mamac sreće' built from the terms for bait and luck, like the guide's 'Napitak sreće'; 'your' dropped as Bosnian UI does.

sell.done.note: Label pairs because count and coins can each be 1 ('1 riba', '2 ribe', '5 riba'). 'Prodato' and 'Prodano' are both standard Bosnian.

ascend.button.note: 'Rise up' to a higher level: not religious (that would be 'uzašašće') and not climbing ('penjati se'). 10/10. 'Prestiž' would also be understood but reads as social status.

ascend.confirm.text: Uzdići se sada? Krenut ćeš ispočetka, ali ćeš rijetke ribe loviti {bonus}% češće.
ascend.confirm.note: Same verb as ascend.button; future tense avoids gendered past; no space before % (CLDR).

weather.storm.note: 'grizu' is the fishing sense ('riba grize' = the fish are biting).

quest.catch_n.note: {n} moved to a label slot: 'ribu/ribe/riba' would change with n. Moonlit Bay = 'Mjesečeva uvala' (terms.json), here in the locative; 'uvala' (cove) suits a fishing spot on a lake.

trade.sent.note: 'Trade offered to player {player}': 'igraču' carries the dative so the name stays undeclined; 'nuditi razmjenu' matches the guide. Literal 'Zahtjev za razmjenu poslan igraču {player}' is 34/33.

trade.accept.note: Fixed head noun 'Igrač' carries the masculine past, so it is correct for any player; 'your' dropped to fit 33.

codes.redeemed.note: redeem = 'iskoristiti' (guide); 'iskorišćen' is the equally Bosnian variant.

afk.kicked.text: Predugo si AFK, pa je pecanje stalo.
afk.kicked.note: 'AFK si' (guide) avoids the gendered 'bio si neaktivan / bila si neaktivna'. Says only that fishing stopped, no kick, as in the source.

event.ends.note: 'Still lasts {time}', the guide's event countdown wording ('ističe' fits offers). For the developer: {time} arrives as '2d 4h'; Bosnian short form is '2 d. 4 h'.

daily.streak.text: {day}. dan zaredom! Vrati se sutra po još nagrada.
daily.streak.note: Streak as an ordinal ('3. dan zaredom' = 3rd day in a row): correct for every value with no plural forms. 'for more' made explicit as more rewards.

tip.night.text: Savjet: neke ribe grizu samo noću.

group.join.text: Pridruži se grupi i dobij 50 besplatnih mamaca!

leaderboard.biggest.note: The usual fishing phrase for the heaviest catch; 'Najteži ulov' could also read as 'hardest catch'.
